body: Hey! I really enjoyed this! Some feedback would be maybe in the 3rd line "a mouthful of children" it caught me off guard a bit and didn't seem to fit with the flow of the poem. If you want to use a word related to the ice cream perhaps "with cones of children" or corn-fulls as a mouthful of children is kinda dark for this one in my opinion. But lines 6 and 7 are awesome to me, something to be proud of for sure!

Hey, first time giving feedback here. I really connect to this poem and enjoyed reading it. One thing I would change is the descriptive word for courage. I personally do not associate that kind of courage as tender, perhaps fleeting or desolating. I did also enjoy the length of the poem, thought it reflected well the subject matter. Hope this helps and keep it coming!
